exposure: number of previous cesarean sections (>=3 vs. 1 previous CS)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 450 women undergoing repeat cesarean sections, divided into those with >=3 previous cesarean sections and those with one previous cesarean section.
finding: Women with three or more previous cesarean sections had a significantly higher risk of dense omental adhesions and bladder injury compared to women with only one previous cesarean section.
mod_finding: The risk of complications such as dense omental adhesions, bladder injury, and blood transfusion was significantly higher in women undergoing higher-order (>=3) cesarean sections compared to those undergoing lower-order (1) cesarean sections.
gest_age: after 38 weeks' gestation (for elective CS in group 1)
